output.answer_markdown: The passages do not contain enough information to say whether CVS Health is capital-intensive in FY2022. The FY2022 passages only describe the business: more than 9,000 retail locations, more than 1,100 walk-in medical clinics, and a pharmacy benefits manager with over 110 million plan members [3][5][7]. They give no capital expenditures, property and equipment, depreciation, total assets or revenue figures, so no capital-intensity measure can be computed.

found: FY2022 10-K: more than 9,000 retail locations and more than 1,100 walk-in medical clinics.
FY2022 10-K: a pharmacy benefits manager with over 110 million plan members and a senior pharmacy care business serving more than one million patients per year.
missing: FY2022 total assets and revenue (to compute ratios such as capex/revenue)
refusal.reason: The FY2022 passages give only a qualitative business description and no financial data (capex, PP&E, depreciation, total assets, revenue) from which capital intensity could be assessed.
